name: Sun-Dried Tomato Spaghetti Alfredo with Spinach & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 (227g ) pkg sliced white mushrooms
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach, Alfredo sauce, pesto, and water to the pot; cook, stirring often, until heated through, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low and allow to simmer gently until the pasta is finished cooking.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (454 g) bags frozen chopped spinach
1 ½ (454 g) jars Alfredo sauce
1 cup sun-dried tomato pesto
⅓ cup water

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and add to the pot with the sauce. Toss to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
